Description.description: A vendor invoice captured for AI extraction. Holds the uploaded source document, the chosen extraction method, the processing lifecycle state, the extracted invoice values, and the diagnostics of the last processing attempt.
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.
Date and time when the record was created.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.
Balance still payable, which can differ from the total when a deposit was already paid.
Value of the Amount Due in base currency.
Postal address the invoice is billed to.
Name of the party the invoice is billed to.
Currency the invoice is denominated in, as returned by extraction (CAD, USD, EUR).
Date payment falls due.
Invoice line items as structured JSON. The MVP deliberately avoids a normalized line-item table.
Overall confidence reported by the extraction model, 0 to 1. Populated only when a meaningful overall value is available.
Which AI extraction approach the flow branches to for this record. Chosen by the user, never inferred from the file.
Date the vendor issued the invoice.
Unique identifier for entity instances
The vendor's invoice number. Optional before processing; populated by extraction.
Correlation identifier of the most recent flow run, used to find the run in Power Automate when diagnosing a failure.
Which extraction path produced the current values, such as Native AI Builder Invoice Model or AI Builder Invoice Custom Prompt.
How many times processing has been attempted. Incremented once per attempt; preserved across failures for troubleshooting.
When the most recent processing attempt finished, on success or failure. Set by the flow.
Short machine-readable failure code from the last attempt. Cleared when a new attempt starts.
User-readable explanation of why the last attempt failed. Cleared when a new attempt starts.
When the current or most recent processing attempt began. Set by the flow.
Where this invoice sits in the processing lifecycle. Users set Draft and Ready to Process; the flow owns Processing, Completed and Failed.
Purchase order the invoice bills against. Populated by extraction when the document carries one.
Compact JSON of the relevant extraction output, kept for troubleshooting. Diagnostic content, not a primary user surface.
Makes an intentional reprocessing request explicit. The flow resets it to No once a new attempt starts.
Makes an intentional reprocessing request explicit. The flow resets it to No once a new attempt starts.
The uploaded invoice PDF or image. Required before the record can move to Ready to Process; read by the processing flow.
Net amount before tax.
Value of the Subtotal in base currency.
Total tax charged on the invoice.
Value of the Tax Amount in base currency.
Gross invoice total including tax.
Value of the Total Amount in base currency.
Full postal address of the supplier, as printed on the invoice.
Legal or trading name of the supplier that issued the invoice.
Supplier tax registration identifier (VAT, GST or equivalent).
Exchange rate for the currency associated with the entity with respect to the base currency.
Sequence number of the import that created this record.
Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.
Date and time when the record was modified.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
Date and time that the record was migrated.
Owner Id
Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record
Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.
Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.
Status of the Invoice
Status of the Invoice
Reason for the status of the Invoice
Reason for the status of the Invoice
For internal use only.
Unique identifier of the currency associated with the entity.
Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.
